# AI Pivot Toolbox

> AI SEO and automation agency serving Australian businesses. Services include AI voice agents, workflow automation, AI SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation), AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation), AI chatbots, website design, app development, and CRM integrations — priced 40–60% below traditional agency rates as a solo AI-powered operator based in Brisbane, Australia.

## Services

- [AI Voice Agents](https://aipivot.com.au/ai-voice-agents): 24/7 inbound call handling, lead qualification, and appointment booking — from $997/month
- [Workflow Automation](https://aipivot.com.au/workflow-automation): Business process automation to eliminate manual tasks — from $1,497/month
- [AI SEO Australia](https://aipivot.com.au/ai-seo-australia): Full-service AI SEO covering Google rankings, GEO, and AEO — from $1,497/month
- [AEO — Answer Engine Optimisation](https://aipivot.com.au/aeo-answer-engine-optimisation): Get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews
- [GEO — Generative Engine Optimisation](https://aipivot.com.au/geo-generative-engine-optimisation): Structured content and technical setup for AI search citation
- [AI Chatbot Australia](https://aipivot.com.au/ai-chatbot-australia): Custom website chatbot trained on your business — from $597/month
- [Website Design with AI](https://aipivot.com.au/website-design-ai): Custom websites with AI chatbot and SEO built in — from $3,497 once-off
- [App Development Australia](https://aipivot.com.au/app-development-australia): Custom AI-powered web and mobile apps — from $7,997
